title: Geometric components over residue fields of separably closed valued fields
statement: Let $K$ be a separably closed field [def-kun-separably-closed, def-weil-field] and $V\subseteq K$ a valuation ring with fraction field $K$, meaning that for every $a\in K^\times$ either $a$ or $a^{-1}$ belongs to $V$. For every prime ideal $\mathfrak p\subset V$, the residue field $k=\operatorname{Frac}(V/\mathfrak p)$ [def-weil-residue-field] is separably closed. Let $Z$ be a scheme of finite type over this $k$ [def-weil-finite-type-morphism] which is geometrically reduced, meaning that $Z_L=Z\times_k\operatorname{Spec}L$ [def-pc-fibre-product] is reduced [def-pc-reduced-scheme] for every field extension $L/k$ [def-pc-field-extension]. Give each irreducible component $C$ of $Z$ its reduced induced closed-subscheme structure [def-weil-irreducible-components, lem-weil-pbc-reduced-induced-closed-subscheme]. Then $C_L$ is integral (reduced and irreducible [def-pc-integral-scheme]) for every field extension $L/k$. For an algebraic closure $\overline k/k$ [def-weil-algebraic-closure], the assignment $C\mapsto C_{\overline k}$ is a bijection from the irreducible components of $Z$ to those of $Z_{\overline k}$, with their reduced induced structures. No finite-height assumption on $V$ is needed.
